trudy.bio:
Trudy is a Montréal singer-songwriter working between contemporary country and pop, with songs in both English and French. Her 2026 releases include “Honey, Have I Lost My Mind?,” “Got Me Good,” “Toutes ces nuits perdues” and “Seen Enough.” The latter was co-written in Vancouver with The Renaissance collective and songwriter Wes Mack.

Her six-track got me good EP, released October 16, also includes “Belong together,” now playing on Northern Dial. Her writing leans into personal turning points, pairing direct storytelling with melodic country-pop arrangements.
trudy.directory_summary: Montréal country-pop singer-songwriter Trudy records in English and French. Her 2026 got me good EP includes “Belong together,” now playing on Northern Dial.

creach.bio:
Creach is an electronic and dance-music artist connected to Vancouver’s independent club scene. Releases spanning “Machine Love,” “Room Full of Cellphones,” “Make It To Monday,” “Adderall” and “Maybe” chart a run of singles and short projects built around dance production and electronic textures.

Creach released “Baby you're a mess” on October 9, 2026. The track is now playing on Northern Dial. The artist also has documented live appearances in Vancouver, including at Platform9.
creach.directory_summary: Vancouver electronic artist Creach released “Baby you're a mess” in October 2026, following singles such as “Adderall” and “Maybe.”

hayku kyah.bio:
Hayku Kyah is a Toronto-born hip-hop artist who grew up in Melbourne, Australia, and describes both cities as home. Starting with spoken-word poetry, Kyah developed a recording practice built around rhythm, wordplay and writing about identity, distance and belonging. Australia’s triple j Unearthed lists tracks including “Swan Dive,” “Lune” and 2026’s “he77.”

The single “ain't no sunshine” arrived in October 2026 and is now playing on Northern Dial. The artist’s Canadian connection is birthplace and early upbringing, not a claim of a current Toronto base.
hayku kyah.directory_summary: Born in Toronto and raised partly in Melbourne, Hayku Kyah combines poetry and hip-hop. The October 2026 single “ain't no sunshine” is on Northern Dial.

matt holubowski.bio:
Matt Holubowski is a self-taught singer-songwriter from Hudson, Québec, whose writing moves between acoustic folk and more expansive arrangements. His earlier work includes Solitudes and Flowers on a Molten Lawn. He works with collaborators including Connor Seidel and has built a long-running career in Québec’s music scene.

“Black Cloud,” released in October 2026, is the lead single from Inside the Merry Loop, an album scheduled for January 22, 2027 through Next Door Records. Co-produced with Warren Spicer, the project returns to shorter songs and the fundamentals of Holubowski’s folk writing while examining repetition, difficult habits and change. “Black Cloud” is now playing on Northern Dial.
matt holubowski.directory_summary: Hudson, Québec folk songwriter Matt Holubowski released “Black Cloud” in October 2026 ahead of Inside the Merry Loop, due January 2027.

oakk.bio:
OAKK is the electronic-music project of Vancouver-based singer and producer Cole Edwards. The project moves between bass music, downtempo production, electronic R&B and club rhythms. Earlier releases include Sunshower E.P., Moving On and the 2024 album I Made This For You.

The 15-track DREAMS & DIVERSIONS arrived October 16, 2026 through not too sweet, following singles “WAY U,” “HONEY,” “SIRENS” and “ENERGY.” “TELL ME,” from the album, is now playing on Northern Dial. The album joins melodic songwriting to electronic production without staying in a single dance-music lane.
oakk.directory_summary: Vancouver producer Cole Edwards records as OAKK. “TELL ME” appears on the October 2026 electronic album DREAMS & DIVERSIONS.

marianne beaulieu.bio:
Marianne Beaulieu is a Montréal indie-folk singer-songwriter who began posting covers online in 2019 after learning piano, voice and guitar. She released her first original material in 2022 and followed with the covers EP Here. in 2024.

Her first EP of original songs, The Committee, arrived in April 2025. Produced by Connor Seidel, the release combines acoustic folk writing and pop arrangements. Beaulieu released the French-language single “Le mauvais temps” in October 2026, which is now playing on Northern Dial. Her music moves between English and French and often draws on everyday feelings and family memories.
marianne beaulieu.directory_summary: Montréal indie-folk songwriter Marianne Beaulieu followed the EP The Committee with the 2026 French-language single “Le mauvais temps.”

featurette.bio:
FEATURETTE is a Toronto alternative electronic-pop group led by vocalist Lexie Jay with keyboardist, guitarist and producer Marc Koecher and drummer Jon Fedorsen. The project began as a duo and grew into a trio. Its songs bring heavy synths, pop hooks and forceful live percussion together, and the band has built a distinct visual world through performance and music videos.

The group released Crave in 2016, Dream Riot in 2020 and Panic Pills in January 2025. Its October 16, 2026 single “TABLE42,” issued through Division Eleven Music, is now playing on Northern Dial.
featurette.directory_summary: Toronto electro-pop trio FEATURETTE features Lexie Jay, Marc Koecher and Jon Fedorsen. Its latest single is October 2026’s “TABLE42.”

chiara savasta.bio:
Chiara Savasta is a Montréal singer-songwriter whose music blends alternative pop, indie rock and electronic production. She began releasing music with Summerhood in 2022 and followed with the 2024 EP brand new girl, brand new machine, a project built around the instability and emotional intensity of early adulthood.

Her 2025 and 2026 singles include “Cross Control Patrol,” “Playlist,” “Necktie,” “Nosebleeds” and “Hi, hello.” Released September 11, 2026 through Cult Nation, “Hi, hello” is now playing on Northern Dial.
chiara savasta.directory_summary: Montréal singer-songwriter Chiara Savasta released the EP brand new girl, brand new machine in 2024 and the 2026 single “Hi, hello.”
album_titles: brand new girl, brand new machine

gus.bio:
GUS is a Toronto-born singer-songwriter whose guitar-led indie-pop songs focus on growing up, relationships, friendship and leaving home. After university, he moved to Los Angeles to write and perform, while remaining connected to Toronto. His live work includes tours with Johnny Orlando and LØLØ.

His releases include “Vivian” and the October 2, 2026 single “Boys of Summer,” now playing on Northern Dial. This profile concerns the contemporary Toronto-born solo artist, not the unrelated Vancouver punk band or other performers who have recorded as Gus.
gus.directory_summary: Toronto-born indie-pop singer-songwriter GUS has toured with Johnny Orlando and LØLØ. His 2026 single “Boys of Summer” is on Northern Dial.
